title: The 90-Day Clinical Licensing Exam Study Plan
subtitle: A structured, independent preparation schedule for the 2026 ASWB Clinical (LCSW) examination
author: The Velvet Foundry Editorial Team
description: You have ninety days before you can sit the Clinical examination again, a free content outline, and a blank study-plan template. This book is the part nobody gives you: the sequenced, dated implementation. It assigns all ninety days across four phases, allocates your study time by the published 2026 area weights, schedules spaced review on named days, and rehearses pacing for a 122-question paper in four hours. It shows you how to turn an outline statement into a self-test question of your own, how to read a failed score report without over-reading it, and what to change when a week goes wrong. Written for the candidate who does not need another pile of content, but a plan that survives contact with a real calendar. Contains no examination questions and no confidential examination material. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by ASWB.

note: Scope is deliberately method, schedule and exam process: planning, self-assessment, retrieval practice, pacing, tracking and logistics. It contains no clinical-treatment teaching, because The Velvet Foundry has no licensed social worker on staff and a licensing examination gates a helping profession. Facts about the examination trace to ASWB's published material, checked October 2026, and are cited in the book so a reader can verify them.
